content: Pojanjiana Kawasana Opu tee Raja Daud

content.text: Iaku bhekulaguaka lagu kaasina KAWASANA OPU molagina saʼumurua,
tee ngangaku bhekupakoleleaka pojanjiamu inda amabhotu saʼumurua zamani.
Iaku kupogau, "Kaasimu molagina amatangka saʼumurua,
tee pojanjiamu inda momabhotu upatotapua i laiana."
Kawasana Opu apogau, "Iaku padhamo kubhoke pojanjia tee mia ipiliku,
Iaku padhamo kupotunda tee Daud, bhatuaku,
'Iaku bhekupatotapuaka manga siwulumu saʼumurua,
tee kubhangu kauncuramakamu to siwulumu naile itu.' " Sela
E KAWASANA OPU, taroakamo manga mahalukuna sorogaa apuji manga giu inda momentela ipewaumu,
tee pojanjiamu inda momabhotu i tanga-tangana rombongana malaaʼekati mangkilo.
Incema buaka i laiana momembalina mopodhimbana tee KAWASANA OPU?
Incema buaka modhaangiana i tanga-tangana mahalukuna sorogaa momembalina motopapokana tee KAWASANA OPU?
Incia o Aulataʼala motohoromati i nuncana majilisina malaaʼekati momangkilo,
amaoge tee atomaeka alabhi minaaka i bhari-bharia modhaangiana i saripina.
E KAWASANA OPU, Aulataʼalana saangua alamu,
incema buaka mopokanana tee ingkoo? Ingkoo umakaa, e KAWASANA OPU,
tee sadia ubukeaka pojanjia inda momabhotu.
Ingkoo mokuasaina ewona tawo;
ande o ewo amalanga, Ingkoo mopekalinoa.
Ingkoo mopahancuruna Rahab
mboomo maeati;
Ingkoo mopapogaa-gaana manga musumu tee kakaamu.
Laiana o pewauamu tee o alamu o pewauamu uka.
Ingkoo mopadhaangiana dunia tee bhari-bharia antona.
Napa tee salata, Ingkoo mopadhaangiaia;
Gunu Tabor tee Hermon uka asambo-sambo roonamo saromu.
Limamu amaoge,
lima kaanamu atopekalanga tee kakaana momulia.
Kabanara tee kaʼadili amembali o fondasina kauncuramakamu,
kaasi molagina tee pojanjiamu inda momabhotu atokamata i nuncana bhari-bharia pewaumu.
Amasanaamo o lipu mosambo-sambona mopujiko,
modhadhina i nuncana caheana roumu, e KAWASANA OPU!
Roonamo saromu manga incia akaunde-unde saeoa,
tee roonamo kabanaramu manga incia apujiko.
Ingkoo o kamuliana kakaana manga incia,
tee roonamo kalapemu, ingkami tahandamo tamakaa.
Katangkesimami o pewauana KAWASANA OPU,
siitumo o rajamami pewauana Aulataʼala Momangkilo isombana miana Israel.
I piamo itu, i nuncana pokamataana mia Ingkoo ufirimani
i manga mia motaʼatiko, mboosii,
"Iaku padhamo kutulungi samia o mia mobarani,
Iaku padhamo kupekalanga samia ipiliku minaaka i lipu sumai.
Iaku padhamo kupokawaaka Daud, o bhatuaku,
tee padhamo kulantia tee mina hususuku momangkilo.
Limaku sadhaadhaa bheajagania,
sampemo limaku uka bhekupekatangkaakea.
Musu inda bheamembali ahumbunia,
tee inda bheapisakia mia madhaki.
Iaku bhekupahancuru manga bhalina i aroana,
tee kupabinasa manga mia mobancia.
Pojanjiaku inda bheamabhotu tee kaasiku molagina bheapobhawa tee incia,
tee roonamo saroku o bheajulu o kakaana.
Iaku bhekupamembali limana akuasai tawo,
tee o lima kaanana akuasai manga umala.
Incia bheagora i Iaku, 'Ingkoomo o Amaku,
Aulataʼalaku, tee gunu bhatu mopasalaamatiaku!'
Iaku uka bhekuangkea to amembali ana tumpeku,
tee kupamembalia momalangana mpuu minaaka i bhari-bharia manga raja i dunia.
To saʼumurua bhekudhambaakea o kaasiku molagina to incia,
tee o pojanjiaku tee incia bheasadhaadhaa amatangka.
Bhekupewaua o siwuluna adhaangia saʼumurua,
tee o kauncuramakana bhekupotaangiakea kangengena laiana dhaangiapo i bhawona dunia.
Ande manga anana inda ataʼati tee hukumuku,
tee o dhadhina inda aose tuturaku,
tee ande manga incia inda aose opea mopadhana ipatotapuakaku,
tee inda aose manga parintaku,
sumaimo bhekuhukumua manga incia tee kasambina lauro,
tee bhekubhebhea roonamo dosana manga incia.
Maka Iaku inda bhekubhotukia o kaasiku molagina to incia,
tee inda bhekumalinguakea pojanjiaku inda momabhotu.
Iaku sadhaadhaa kupamondo pojanjiaku,
tee opea mopadhana ifirimaniakaku inda bhekubhaliia.
Sampearo to saʼumurua Iaku kusumpa to kangkilona saroku,
tee inda bhekugau-gau Daud.
Siwuluna bheadhaangia to saʼumurua,
tee o kauncuramakana bheasadhaadhaa i aroaku mboomo matanaeo,
bheasadhaadhaa saʼumurua mboomo bula,
mosakusiiakea minaaka i laiana." Sela
Maka sii-sii Ingkoo umendeua tee ubholia;
Ingkoo upamuru tee mia mopadhana ilantimu.
Ingkoo ubhotuki janjimu tee bhatuamu,
tee o mahakotana upekarombuakea tee ngawuna tana.
Upatobhatea bhari-bharia manga rindina kotana,
tee upahancurua manga bentena.
Bhari-bharia mia molalo amanako pewauana;
incia amembali giuna kaele-ele to manga sarimbanuana.
Ingkoo upekalanga lima kaanana manga bhalina,
tee bhari-bharia musuna upewaua akaunde-unde.
Ingkoo uka upamembali matana ewangana rajamami inda akoampadhea,
tee inda utulungia i nuncana potimbea.
Upauntoa o kuasana momuliana,
tee o kauncuramakana utudhaakea i tana.
Upekampodhoa o umuruna rajamami wakutuuna amangura,
tee usalibumbungiakea tee kaea. Sela
Sakawana naepia uka e KAWASANA OPU? Buaka bheubuniaka karomu saʼumurua?
Sakawana naepia o pamurumu akarore-rore mboomo waa?
Udhania, tapanamo kampodho o dhadhiku sii,
tapanamo sia-siana dhadhina bhari-bharia maanusia ipadhaangiamu!
Incema buaka o maanusia momembalina modhadhina torosu tee inda amate?
Tee incema momembalina mopasalaamatina inyawana tee alapa minaaka i mate? Sela
E Kawasana Opu, i iapai o kaasimu molagina i piamo itu
mopadhana ijanjiakamu to Daud tee katunda i nuncana pojanjiamu inda momabhotu?
E Kawasana Opu, udhania tuaapa o bhatuamu sii atohina;
incaku atanggo kahinana bhari lipu.
Manga musumu ahina raja mopadhana ilantimu, e KAWASANA OPU,
manga incia aele-elea iapaipo uka o lingkaana.
Pujimo KAWASANA OPU to saʼumurua!
Aamin, ya aamin!

footnotes.text: Etan, miana Ezrahi: Sifatu aarifuna Etan tee Heman atomatau mpuu, ruamiaia o miana Ezrahi (kamata 88:1). Manga ahalii Kitabi Momangkilo aabhia ande o Etan miana Ezrahi sii satotuuna o saro mosagaanana to asarongiaka Yedutun, sala samia minaaka i talu mia (Asaf, Heman, tee Yedutun) ipatugasina Nabii Daud to akapalai lagu wakutuuna asambahea i Baitulla.
